# code-ds (vendored)

A copy of the CODE design system's `src/` at commit `01966af` of
`github.com/elfacko5/CODE-design-system` (the integration Lidd was phone-tested
against: keyboard plugin, contrast-app-modes, font-weight-roles). It is here so
the build needs no sibling folder and no access to a private repo, which Vercel
does not have. `@base-ui/react` is a dependency of the app itself for the same
reason. Change it here, or re-copy `src/` from the design-system repo and note
the new commit in this file.
